title: final keyword trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for final trace events: a list of bindings (each carrying its context, whether it is locked, and whether it references a mutable object) plus an optional one-line note about an assignment attempt or a mutation.

context.description: where final appears: a local variable, a static constant, an instance field, a method parameter, a method, or a class

type.description: declared type, e.g. int, double, List; null for a method or class

value.description: current bound value or object contents; null for a method or class

locked.description: is the binding locked (assigned exactly once)? false for a blank final not yet assigned

mutable.description: does the binding reference a mutable object whose contents can still change?

note.description: An optional one-line note shown beside the bindings: an assignment, a rejected reassignment, or a mutation.

expr.description: the line of code being shown

status.description: locked = binding fixed; assigned = blank final set once; blocked = reassignment rejected; mutated = object contents changed
